name: Craft Self (Item Creation)
body:
You learn how to improve the enchantments on your physical body.

Prerequisite(s) Half-construct or construct, Caster Level 5th

Benefit(s) You may enchant your physical body as a magical weapon, suit of armor, or wondrous item.

The portion of your body enchanted corresponds to the appropriate body slot. You act as if you possess both the Craft Magic Arms and Armor, and Craft Wondrous Item feats. If you possess either of these feats, you gain a +5 bonus on all skill checks made to enchant your own body, and you receive a 10% discount on enhancements added in this manner.

Portions of your body enchanted are still subject to all limitations on magical item slots (so you cannot enchant your hands and then also wear magical gloves). If you are ever killed, the enchantments return if you are resurrected from the dead in any manner. If you enchant your body with an armor enhancement, you may not enchant yourself with any body slot enhancements, and vice versa.
